reportTitle.title: reportTitle
reportTitle.description: The report title / headline, e.g. 'MidOcean — Agentforce Use-Case Research'.

clientName.title: clientName
clientName.description: The client or workshop name shown in the report header, e.g. 'MidOcean'.

executiveSummary.title: executiveSummary
executiveSummary.description: A short executive summary of the workshop and the opportunity. Plain text or simple HTML.

useCases.title: useCases
useCases.description: The prioritized use cases. Strongly prefer an HTML table with columns Use case / Impact / Effort / What it does. Plain text is also accepted.

webResearch.title: webResearch
webResearch.description: A summary of relevant findings from the web search, as HTML (paragraphs/lists) or plain text. Include the key insights for this client's use cases.

salesforceGuidance.title: salesforceGuidance
salesforceGuidance.description: A summary of relevant Salesforce / Agentforce documentation guidance, as HTML or plain text.

recommendations.title: recommendations
recommendations.description: Concrete recommended next steps for the client, as an HTML list or newline-separated plain text.

sources.title: sources
sources.description: Sources and links used, ideally as an HTML list of <a> links (from the web search citations and Salesforce documentation), or newline-separated URLs.

recordId.title: recordId
recordId.description: Optional. The Salesforce record Id to associate the note with. Leave blank for a standalone note.
